だけで.en: だけで means ‘just by (A), (B)’ or ‘with only (A), (B)’. We are looking for a grammar point that means ‘simply because of (A), (B)’, often highlighting regret or an unfortunate result.

のに.en: のに means 'despite' and highlights an unexpected result or contrast. We are looking for a grammar point that means ‘simply because of (A), (B)’, usually with regret or an unfortunate result.

ところが.en: ところが means 'however' or 'even so'. We are looking for a grammar point that means ‘simply because of (A), (B)’, usually with regret or an unfortunate result.

attributes.body_ja:
「ばかりに」は、「ばかり」と格助詞（かくじょし）「に」を合（あ）わせたもので、「ただ (A) だけで」という意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。「(A) だけが原因（げんいん）・理由（りゆう）で、(B) が起（お）きた・(B) が可能（かのう）だ」という状況（じょうきょう）で使（つか）われます。また、この表現（ひょうげん）は、動詞（どうし）の過去形（かこけい）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）われることが多（おお）いです。その場合（ばあい）は、過去（かこ）に起（お）こったことが、ある結果（けっか）を招（まね）いたことを表（あらわ）します。「ばかりに」は、連体形（れんたいけい）の語（ご）のあとに付（つ）けて使（つか）います。

この文法（ぶんぽう）は、結果（けっか）が悪（わる）いときに使（つか）われることがほとんどですが、絶対（ぜったい）ではありません。また、「たい」や「ほしい」のような文法（ぶんぽう）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）えば、強（つよ）い気持（きも）ちや願（ねが）いを表（あらわ）すこともできます。

豆知識（まめちしき）

「ばかり」の説明（せつめい）でも触（ふ）れましたが、「ばかり」は漢字（かんじ）で書（か）くと「許（ばか）り」になります。この漢字（かんじ）には「範囲（はんい）を限（かぎ）って、そこだけ許（ゆる）す」ようなイメージがあります、「ばかりに」は、「ただ (A) をしただけで、(B) になった」と、驚（おどろ）いたり意外（いがい）に感（かん）じたりする気持（きも）ちを表（あらわ）すこともできます。この「ただ〜だけで」というニュアンスは、「許（ゆる）す」という漢字（かんじ）のイメージと関連（かんれん）づけて覚（おぼ）えるといいかもしれません。

豆知識（まめちしき）

「ばかり」の「許（ゆる）す」という漢字（かんじ）には、「認（みと）める」「通（とお）す」「責（せ）めない」のような意味（いみ）もあります。
attributes.body:
When paired with the case marking particle に, ばかり regularly conveys the meaning of 'simply because', or 'just because'. Literally, this expression means that 'even with just (A), (B) is/was able to occur'. This phrase is regularly paired with the past form of verbs, indicating that something that has already taken place, led to some other result.

To use ばかりに, simply attach the expression to the end of any word in its attributive form.

It should be noted that this particular grammar pattern has a strong tendency to be used with results that are negative. However, this is not a requirement. A high level of eagerness/enthusiasm can also be expressed when paired with grammar points like たい, or ほしい.

Fun Fact

As we mention in our ばかり grammar point, one of the more common kanji that ばかり stems from is '許', which means to be 'let off' or 'let through'. It implies a minimum amount of something that is then deemed as 'permissible'. This nuance is kept in ばかりに, as the (A) part of the sentence is being highlighted as that minimum extent of something for which the (often surprising) result of (B) is/was possible. Due to this, translations such as 'even with only/just (A), (B)' are quite similar to ばかりに, so long as it is clear that (A) is surprising.

Fun Fact

The kanji that is used most frequently for ばかり is the same kanji that is used for 許（ゆる）す 'to forgive'. In this particular use of 許, it still means 'to let off', or 'to let through', as 'to forgive' quite often has the nuance of letting something through/pass/slide.

attributes.description: Further breakdown of ばかりに

attributes.body: They may seem similar because both can be translated as 'just because', but mean very different things. ばかりに expresses, often with regret, a negative outcome caused by a single reason, e.g. 一回遅刻したばかりにクビになった ('I was fired just because I was late once.'). In contrast, からといって means 'just because (A), it doesn't mean (B)', e.g. お金持ちだからといって幸せとは限らない ('Just because someone is rich doesn't mean they're happy.').

first_relatable.title: ばかりに
first_relatable.meaning: Simply because, Only because, Just because, Simply on account of

attributes.body: These expressions are loosely related in that both indicate a reason. ばかりに conveys that a specific cause led to a negative outcome, often with a nuance of regret, e.g. 忘れ物をしたばかりに受験できなかった ('Just because I forgot something, I couldn't take the exam'). につき, by contrast, is a formal, neutral expression often used in official contexts, e.g. 工事中につき通行止め ('Road closed due to construction').

attributes.body: ばかり means 'only' or 'just', often with a neutral or excessive nuance, e.g. 寝てばかりいる ('He does nothing but sleep'). ばかりに adds a nuance of regret, expressing that something bad happened solely because of one reason, e.g. 寝坊したばかりに電車に乗り遅れた ('I missed the train just because I overslept').
